chunks: And throw down your staff. When he saw it wriggling as if it were a serpent, he turned about and fled without turning back. "O Moses, approach and have no fear. Indeed, you are of the safe."
ai.seo_question: What happened when Moses threw his staff during the miracle?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, Moses' initial flight is interpreted not as cowardice but as a natural human reaction to the divine manifestation (tajalli), highlighting the transition from prophetic humility to confident leadership. The command 'Do not fear' serves as a foundational assurance of divine protection (ismah) for the Prophet, reinforcing his status as a chosen vessel for conveying God's message against Pharaoh's tyranny.
